notes.title: 0.2.7 - Display name, fix sky color when colors found and more!
notes.notes:
Player id is now show over the player in multiplayer, Steam username coming soon!

The sky get some colors when you found the color ball!

Enhancement of the visual (add shadows)

Enhancement of the tutorial!

notes.title: 0.2.6 - UI Enhancement for the countdown and more!
notes.notes: Enhance the UI for the countdown by adding a sound effect. Improve the tutorial (loading screen) to visually show what the player needs to find.

notes.title: 0.2.5a - Multiplayer/Single Player Quick Fix
notes.notes: Fix an issue that occurs when the user quits multiplayer to play single-player.

notes.title: 0.2.5 - Sound Effects When a Color Is Found
notes.notes: Added sound effects when a color is found.

notes.title: 0.2.4 - Animations in the multiplayer lobby
notes.notes: The character in multiplayer lobby now has a random animation loop

notes.title: 0.2.3 - UI Enhancement for Tracking Found Colors by Players
notes.notes: In a game, you can view the list of participants and track which player found which color.

notes.title: 0.2.2 - Chat enabled in the lobby
notes.notes: Enable real-time chat in the lobby!

notes.title: 0.2.1 - Multiplayer is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
The first version of the multiplayer mode is now officially live!

New features will be deployed in the coming days. Stay tuned!
